programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: Two Fathers: Justice for the Innocent
programme.desc: Two fathers from very different backgrounds reunite after eight years to pursue the escaped drug dealer responsible for the deaths of their son and daughter.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Baskonia" - "Fenerbahce"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Panathinaikos" - "Olympiacos"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

It's feeding season, as thousands of normally elusive predators join forces to hunt and feed on super-shoals of fish known as bait balls. programme.title: Out There with Jack Randall
programme.desc: At the tender age of 14, Jack Randall left his home in the UK to work under the guidance of legendary wildlife expert Steve Irwin. Developing his skills of handling reptiles and snakes, Randall learned important skills under Irwin's tutelage that remain with him today. Now an accomplished zoologist, Randall is continuing his studies into wild and exotic species, visiting harsh landscapes and unrelenting environments to explore these animal's behaviours. Using his bold and courageous approach, Randall gets up close and personal with deadly snakes, vicious crocodiles, boisterous kangaroos, fierce camels and many other dangerous species.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: World's Weirdest

Take this amazing journey to the animal world and have a look at creatures who survive in extreme environments, alien-looking body parts and camouflage, fish that can change its sex, toads that explode, koalas and their disgusting diet and all kinds of other weirdest creatures Mother Nature has to offer.

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Lucy Cooke is on a one-woman mission to show why the ugly, weird and overlooked animals of the world can be cute, cuddly and deserving of attention. Join her as she heads off to the rainforests of Borneo. Borneo is its own very unique crucible of weirdness - with countless strange creatures that can only be found there. Lucy's goal is get up close with the giant-nosed proboscis monkey to figure out why this creature looks so strange. Along the way, she finds many other "odd ones" - animals that have come up with all kinds of strange adaptations so they can survive in the forest of Borneo. Lucy finds dung beetles in action - eating dung; frogs that fly; a tarsier, with eyes that are bigger than its brain; and the wooly bat that makes its home is a carnivorous plant.

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Typically South Africa is known for the Big Five: lions, leopards, buffalo, elephants and rhinos. But not for Lucy Cooke, advocate and avenger for the lesser-known and unloved animals of the world. Lucy's on a hunt for the more enigmatic Freaky Five: Cape vultures, sungazer girdled lizards, golden-brown baboon tarantulas, ground pangolins, and chacma baboons. The Freaky Five are all important to South Africans and their traditions. Mystical and mysterious, these five animals represent a side of South African culture that the tourists and conservation donors both often overlook. But Lucy Cooke is on a mission to change all of that!

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The long-awaited spinoff of the legendary The Incredible Dr. Pol franchise has finally hatched! Spearheaded by Dr. Pol and his son Charles, the Pol familys three generations are all joining forces to grow their animal loving empire and take on an ambitious new project: transforming 350-acres of undeveloped land into a fully functional family farm!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Wild Lapland
programme.desc: A lyrical portrayal of the enchanting, wild creatures who call Lapland home.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Snow School
programme.desc: When every day is a snow day, school is always in session! Snowy climates can make for harsh living, and adulting is hard no matter where you are, but these young are flourishing; a baby walrus gets a swim lesson from Mom, young stoats' playtime teaches them how to hunt, otter pups take a slide and learn to avoid predators, and owlets practice leaving the nest. programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother. She wakes from hibernation, thin and weary, to guide cubs through a fleeting summer. They need food, and she'll teach them everything, not least of all, avoiding dangerous males during mating season and facing wolves in a deadly fight for food. Every day counts in these forests. When winter returns, only the strong and the wise will endure this wild, unforgiving land.

programme.title: Alaska's Deadliest: Predator Prowl
programme.desc: The biggest state in the union is also home to some of the deadliest predators. Alaska is one of the few remaining true wildernesses left on the planet. With its harsh environment, extreme cold and constant winter darkness it is not a place for the fainthearted. As springtime buds and the sun raises its head above the horizon, the state's predatory carnivores emerge on to the vast landscapes to hunt for food, with wolves, brown bears and wolverines dispatching prey with ease. In the waters along the coastline, giant orcas and salmon sharks track and kill their quarry while tiny terrors hide in the channels and make good use of their venomous attacks.

programme.title: Race to Winter
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. As the first light of spring touches snow-covered landscapes, the race begins. Across fjords, forests, mountains and tundra, animals emerge from hiding to take advantage of summer's fleeting generosity.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: A forensic look at how cheetahs hunt their prey, offering new perspectives on the tactics employed by these expert predators when stalking, chasing and bringing down antelope and wildebeest. Following a young cheetah mother over 18-months as she teaches her three cubs the secrets of the hunt.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Killer Three
programme.desc: This series looks at the natural born killers of the animal kingdom with each episode focusing on a particular, shared aspect of what makes these creatures successful predators. In 'Little Killers', we see how a lack of physical size can be overcome when hunting prey and miniscule attackers are able to bring down prey that are massive in comparison. In 'Speed Kills', the spotlight is shone on those predators who use their incredibly fast skills to catch their food. From the fastest animal on land, the cheetah, to the stargazer fish that dispatches its prey in a tenth of a second to the deadly black mamba, some of these attacks are so fast that they cannot be captured using slow-motion. In 'Hunger Games', the emphasis is placed on the driving force behind the majority of attacks, the desire for food.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Back at the party, Vicky, rotten as ever, forces the kids to make crafts for her online store instead of having fun. Hazel comes up with a plan full of zany traps to stop Vicky and take the party back! When Dev discovers his dad has been researching Hazel instead of spending time with him, Dev lashes out at Hazel and wishes Peri away. Left alone with his anger, is there a devious plan hatching in Dev's mind?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When Hazel wishes to be 13 so that she can go see a PG-13 movie by herself, Cosmo and Wanda turn her into a teenager. They go the mall and have a blast doing "teenage things" while they wait for the movie. But, as a side effect of her wish, Hazel starts going through the fairy version of puberty: pasta puberty! As she struggles to deal with pesto pimples and mozzarella mood swings, Hazel wishes that Cosmo and Wanda would just get lost! They disappear, leaving Hazel to deal with the zany pasta puberty alone. // Hazel wishes to be a fairy to join Cosmo and Wanda at their Fairy Convention, but since it's against Da Rules, she settles on looking like a fairy instead. Once at the con, however, Hazel stumbles into the DMV booth and signs a "Fairy-fication" certificate, turning her into a real fairy! It also brings her anti-fairy into existence, who steals the certificate. Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda must get the certificate back from her anti-fairy, or Hazel will be stuck as a fairy forever!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel wishes to meet a dinosaur. Cosmo and Wanda bring Bary, a Baryonyx from the Cretaceous period, to present day. Hazel makes wishes to find Bary a job but unfortunately, Bary never quite fits in. Worse, his giant dinosaur tail knocks out power to the whole city, ruining Dimmadelphia's prized Electric Light Ice Cream Float Parade. With Hazel feeling remorseful, Bary musters inspiration from his hero, the great Thomas Rex-ison, and uses his dinosaur smarts to try to save the day. // Hazel has planned a night of watching scary movies with her new friend, Jasmine, but it turns out Jasmine hates scary movies. Rather than change the plan, Hazel wishes Jasmine had no fears. When Cosmo and Wanda grant the wish, the fears escape Jasmine's mind, coming into the real world. Hazel tries fighting the fears off but learns it's Jasmine who must face them to make them disappear. Now, she's got to talk her new friend into doing everything she's most afraid of, which gets the attention of Fear Itself!

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Monako AS - Liono "Olympic"
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: Il ritmo serrato del thriller per ripercorrere uno storico evento mediatico. 1972: durante le Olimpiadi di Monaco di Baviera, un commando palestinese uccide due atleti israeliani e ne prende in ostaggio nove. Una troupe della ABC documenta i drammatici eventi in tempo reale.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io
programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: Era mio figlio
programme.desc: Todd Robinson dirige un cast d’eccezione per un war movie tratto da una storia vera. Il paracadutista William Pitsenbarger fu un eroe caduto nella guerra del Vietnam. Trent’anni dopo un ambizioso membro del Pentagono cercherà di fargli ottenere la medaglia d’onore.

programme.desc: Un ragazzo geniale, cresciuto da una madre amorevole, mette a repentaglio i propri successi e il proprio futuro per liberare il padre, che è in prigione. Questa sua rischiosa impresa mette alla prova i legami familiari e le ambizioni personali.

programme.title: Elizabeth

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River

programme.desc: 3 premi Oscar 2022 al remake di Sian Heder premiato al Sundance. Ruby, unica udente in una famiglia di sordomuti, sogna un futuro nel canto ma non vuole lasciare i suoi cari.

programme.title: La luce sugli oceani
programme.desc: Michael Fassbender e Alicia Vikander in un dramma sulla pericolosa scelta di una coppia. Un guardiano del faro e sua moglie salvano una neonata alla deriva e la crescono in segreto.

programme.title: Finale a sorpresa - Official Competition
programme.desc: Penelope Cruz e Antonio Banderas in una commedia sul mondo del cinema. Per realizzare un film, un miliardario ingaggia un'eccentrica regista e due divi in competizione tra loro.

programme.title: Siccita'
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello al film di Paolo Virzi' con un grande cast corale. In una Roma in cui non piove da tre anni, fra divieti e disagi, si incrociano i destini di un gruppo di individui.

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Michael Gracey confeziona un originale biopic su Robbie Williams, rappresentato sullo schermo da una scimmia: da timido bambino diventerà una pop star internazionale.

programme.title: Il quinto potere
programme.desc: Il fenomeno WikiLeaks nel thriller biografico con Benedict Cumberbatch. La storia della piattaforma online e del suo fondatore Julian Assange che ha fatto tremare i governi del mondo.

programme.title: Il mio nome e' Nessuno
programme.desc: Terence Hill e Henry Fonda nello 'spaghetti western' restaurato di Tonino Valerii, prodotto da Sergio Leone. Un anziano pistolero affronta l'ultima impresa prima di lasciare il Far West.

programme.title: Mi chiamo Francesco Totti
programme.desc: Francesco Totti si racconta nel documentario di Alex Infascelli. Nella notte che precede l'addio al calcio, il capitano della Roma ripercorre le emozioni della sua vita privata e sportiva.

programme.title: Speciale - Gomorra - Le Origini
programme.desc: Tutti i segreti del dietro le quinte di Gomorra Le Origini, la serie che racconta l’iniziazione criminale di Pietro Savastano.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Un immenso Jim Carrey nella sconvolgente metafora dei nostri tempi. Dal giorno della nascita, a sua insaputa, Truman vive sorvegliato dalle telecamere nel piu' estremo dei reality show.

programme.title: Il socio
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di John Grisham, thriller di Sydney Pollack con Gene Hackman e Tom Cruise. Assunto da un prestigioso studio legale, un avvocato inesperto viene coinvolto in loschi intrighi.

programme.title: La luce sugli oceani
programme.desc: Michael Fassbender e Alicia Vikander in un dramma sulla pericolosa scelta di una coppia. Un guardiano del faro e sua moglie salvano una neonata alla deriva e la crescono in segreto.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: Il quinto potere
programme.desc: Il fenomeno WikiLeaks nel thriller biografico con Benedict Cumberbatch. La storia della piattaforma online e del suo fondatore Julian Assange che ha fatto tremare i governi del mondo.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket (Edizione Deluxe)
programme.desc: La 'sporca guerra' secondo Stanley Kubrick in un film epocale con Matthew Modine. Al campo di addestramento di Parris Island il severissimo sergente di ferro Hartman addestra diciassette reclute a diventare spietati marines: i suoi metodi, durissimi e mortificanti, sono in grado di trasformare i soldati in vere e proprie macchine da guerra, pronte per affrontare l'orrore del conflitto in Vietnam. Come il soldato Joker e il soldato Cowboy che si ritroveranno al fronte, nel cuore del paese di Ho Chi Minh, nel mirino di un misterioso cecchino viet cong.

programme.title: Red Snake
programme.desc: Un cast femminile per entrare nel cuore del conflitto in Kurdistan. Venduta come schiava del sesso a un combattente dell’Isis, una ragazza yazida si unisce a un gruppo di guerrigliere.

programme.title: Jurassic World - La rinascita
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Mahershala Ali nel settimo kolossal della saga, diretto da Gareth Edwards. Su un'isola abitata da voraci mostri preistorici, una squadra speciale deve estrarre dal sangue delle creature un campione di DNA con cui sviluppare un farmaco rivoluzionario.

programme.desc: Chris Pratt e Bryce Dallas Howard nel primo capitolo della nuova trilogia prodotta da Spielberg. Per attrarre più visitatori, gli scienziati progettano un dinosauro geneticamente modificato.

programme.desc: Chris Pratt e Bryce Dallas Howard nel secondo capitolo della nuova trilogia. Owen e Claire scoprono una cospirazione mentre tentano di salvare i dinosauri da un'eruzione.

programme.title: Il gatto con gli stivali
programme.desc: Il celebre felino e' il protagonista dello spin-off della saga di Shrek. Dopo una rapina finita male, l'amicizia fra Gatto e Humpty Dumpty si e' rotta, ma il destino li fara' rincontrare.

programme.title: La musica nel cuore - August Rush
programme.desc: Freddie Highmore e Robin Williams in un film toccante e magico. Il piccolo August, prodigio della musica, suona per le strade di New York sperando di rintracciare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.title: Mia e il leone bianco
programme.desc: Daniah De Villiers e Mélanie Laurent nella toccante storia di un legame impossibile. Trasferitasi in Sudafrica con i genitori, Mia stringe amicizia con un cucciolo di leone bianco.

programme.title: Bla Bla Baby
programme.desc: Commedia di Fausto Brizzi con Alessandro Preziosi e Matilde Gioli. Dopo aver ingerito degli omogeneizzati contaminati, il maestro di un asilo nido inizia a decifrare le urla dei bambini.

programme.title: Cattivissimo me
programme.desc: Primo capitolo dell'animazione campione d'incassi targata Illumination. Aiutato dai Minions, il perfido Gru escogita un piano per rubare la Luna, ma 3 orfanelle tentano di ostacolarli.

programme.title: Cattivissimo Me 2
programme.desc: L'irresistibile sequel della trilogia che ha conquistato i botteghini. Gru e i Minions tornano in azione affiancati dall'agente Lucy Wilde per sconfiggere il temibile El Macho.

programme.title: Cattivissimo me 3
programme.desc: Terzo successo al box office per i personaggi targati Illumination. Mentre i Minions si dimettono, Gru scopre di avere un fratello gemello, Dru. Insieme daranno la caccia a Balthazar Bratt.

programme.title: Cattivissimo me 4
programme.desc: Quarto capitolo della saga d'animazione targata Illumination. Presi di mira dal criminale Maxime Le Mal, Gru e i suoi familiari sono costretti a cambiare identità e a trasferirsi in un luogo sicuro. Intanto i dirigenti della Lega Anti-Cattivi trasformano cinque Minions in agenti speciali dotati di superpoteri.

programme.desc: Kevin Costner e Diane Lane in un dramma dai risvolti thrilling. Uno sceriffo e la moglie lasciano il ranch nel Montana per salvare la nuora e il nipote da una famiglia di criminali.

programme.title: Still Life
programme.desc: Struggente riflessione sulla vita premiata a Venezia. Il lavoro di John May e' organizzare il funerale delle persone morte in solitudine. Il suo ultimo incarico gli farà scoprire se stesso.

programme.title: Gioventù bruciata
programme.desc: Un classico intramontabile che consacrò il mito di James Dean. Nell'America degli anni '50 un gruppo di ragazzi inquieti e tormentati si ribella al mondo degli adulti. Una generazione allo sbando alla ricerca della propria strada, alla ricerca del brivido ogni oltre limite. Golden Globe a Natalie Wood, nel film d'esordio per un allora diciannovenne Dennis Hopper. Uscito nella sale americane a breve distanza dalla morte di James Dean, avvenuta proprio in un incidente stradale il 30 settembre 1955, quando l'attore aveva girato appena tre film.

programme.title: Alla vita
programme.desc: Riccardo Scamarcio e Lou de Laage nell'opera prima di Stephane Freiss. Una giovane, di famiglia ebrea ortodossa, incontra un uomo con cui esplora il desiderio di ribellarsi alla tradizione.

programme.title: Tre piani
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti adatta il romanzo di Eshkol Nevo in una pellicola di cui è anche interprete insieme a Margherita Buy, Riccardo Scamarcio e Alba Rohrwacher. Solitudini, amori e ossessioni si intrecciano nei destini di tre famiglie di uno stesso palazzo della Roma bene.

programme.title: Era mio figlio (2024)
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Diane Kruger in una pellicola sul rimpianto di Savi Gabizon. Un ricco magnate scopre di aver avuto un figlio, morto in un incidente, e decide di scavare nel suo passato.

programme.title: Ogni maledetta domenica
programme.desc: Oliver Stone dirige Al Pacino e un cast di divi per descrivere il mondo del football americano attraverso la storia di un allenatore in crisi, alla guida di una squadra che non sa piu' vincere. Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.
Silvio Soldini dirige Kasia Smutniak in una pellicola sulla responsabilita' verso il prossimo. La vita di un'avvocatessa viene sconvolta quando assiste alla morte di un giovane immigrato.

programme.title: In viaggio con Adele
programme.desc: Alessandro Haber, Sara Serraiocco e Isabella Ferrari in un toccante road movie. Un anziano attore scopre di avere una figlia e parte con lei per un viaggio che cambiera' le loro vite.

programme.title: Ogni maledetta domenica

Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.

programme.title: Una vita in fuga
programme.desc: Sean Penn dirige e interpreta con la figlia Dylan il biopic su John Vogel. La doppia vita del piu' famoso e inafferrabile truffatore d'America, raccontata dal punto di vista della figlia.

programme.title: Tre piani
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti adatta il romanzo di Eshkol Nevo in una pellicola di cui è anche interprete insieme a Margherita Buy, Riccardo Scamarcio e Alba Rohrwacher. Solitudini, amori e ossessioni si intrecciano nei destini di tre famiglie di uno stesso palazzo della Roma bene.

programme.title: L'ombra del giorno
programme.desc: Giuseppe Piccioni dirige Riccardo Scamarcio e Benedetta Porcaroli. Ascoli Piceno, 1938: un ristoratore filofascista s'innamora della sua nuova cameriera. Ma la ragazza nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: Era mio figlio (2024)
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Diane Kruger in una pellicola sul rimpianto di Savi Gabizon. Un ricco magnate scopre di aver avuto un figlio, morto in un incidente, e decide di scavare nel suo passato.

programme.title: Natale con Bob
programme.desc: Luke Treadaway e l’irresistibile gatto rosso nel sequel del biopic "A spasso con Bob". James ripercorre i Natali da tossicodipendente prima del salvifico incontro con il suo gatto.

programme.title: Per niente al mondo
programme.desc: Guido Caprino prova a riprendere in mano la sua vita nel film di Ciro D'Emilio. La vita di Bernardo cambia drasticamente quando viene incarcerato con l'accusa di associazione a delinquere.

programme.title: A proposito di Schmidt
programme.desc: 2 Golden Globe al film di Alexander Payne con Jack Nicholson e Kathy Bates. Un vedovo attraversa l'America in un viaggio alla scoperta delle sue emozioni più profonde.

programme.title: Mystic River
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Penn e Tim Robbins, in un capolavoro di Clint Eastwood. L'omicidio di una ragazza riporta alla luce un caso di pedofilia che coinvolse tre bambini di Boston.

programme.title: Tartarughe all'infinito
programme.desc: Aza Holmes, sedicenne affetta da disturbo ossessivo compulsivo e ansia, indaga sulla scomparsa di un miliardario, che è anche il padre di un suo vicino di casa.

programme.title: Non odiare
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Sara Serraiocco nell'opera prima di Mauro Mancini, ispirata a una storia vera. Un chirurgo ebreo lascia morire un uomo, ferito in un incidente, per una svastica tatuata sul petto. Turbato dai sensi di colpa, assume la figlia della vittima come colf.

programme.title: Natale con Bob
programme.desc: Luke Treadaway e l’irresistibile gatto rosso nel sequel del biopic "A spasso con Bob". James ripercorre i Natali da tossicodipendente prima del salvifico incontro con il suo gatto.

programme.title: A Chiara
programme.desc: Ritratto di un'adolescente coraggiosa diretto da Jonas Carpignano premiato a Cannes. Quando il padre fugge, Chiara fa i conti con un'amara verita'. David di Donatello a Swamy Rotolo.

programme.title: A proposito di Schmidt
programme.desc: 2 Golden Globe al film di Alexander Payne con Jack Nicholson e Kathy Bates. Un vedovo attraversa l'America in un viaggio alla scoperta delle sue emozioni più profonde.

programme.title: La migliore offerta
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.title: Tartarughe all'infinito
programme.desc: Aza Holmes, sedicenne affetta da disturbo ossessivo compulsivo e ansia, indaga sulla scomparsa di un miliardario, che è anche il padre di un suo vicino di casa.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.title: Una figlia
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo cresce la figlia in simbiosi dopo la morte della moglie. Quando cerca di ricostruirsi una vita con una nuova compagna, la reazione della figlia metterà a dura prova il suo amore paterno e la sua capacità di perdonare.

programme.title: Un eroe
programme.desc: Grand Prix della Giuria a Cannes per il pluripremiato Asghar Farhadi. Un detenuto rinuncia a una borsa piena d'oro restituendola al proprietario. Diventera' un eroe ma con esiti imprevisti.

programme.title: Gli ultimi saranno ultimi
programme.desc: Dramma sociale di Massimiliano Bruno con Paola Cortellesi e Alessandro Gassmann. La vita di una donna, licenziata perche' incinta, si intreccia con quella di un poliziotto tormentato.

programme.title: Fire Squad - Incubo di fuoco
programme.desc: Spettacolare film drammatico con Jeff Bridges, Josh Brolin e Jennifer Connelly ispirato alle vicende di un gruppo di pompieri addestrati nel combattere gli incendi di montagna. Un pauroso incendio in Arizona sara' la loro tragica prova del fuoco.

programme.title: Orlando
programme.desc: Daniele Vicari dirige una favola moderna con un intenso Michele Placido. In Belgio per rivedere il figlio ricoverato in ospedale, un anziano contadino scopre di avere una nipote.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.title: Anime nere
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Gioacchino Criaco, un viaggio infernale nel cuore della 'Ndrangheta. In un paesino dell'Aspromonte, l'atto intimidatorio del ventenne Leo nei confronti di un clan rivale riunisce dopo molti anni tre fratelli. Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.title: Trilogia di Istanbul - Muhabbet
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek ritorna alla sua terra natale con tre cortometraggi. Una tavola circondata da amici alimenta conversazioni intime che si chiamano Muhabbet.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Compro oro
programme.desc: Tornano i protagonisti del BarLume nel 17esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre Massimo aiuta la Fusco nelle indagini, una coppia di italoamericani fa il suo ingresso a Pineta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - A bocce ferme
programme.desc: Nuove indagini a Pineta nel 18esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre i vecchini aiutano Massimo e la Fusco, Beppe e Tiziana cercano di ritagliarsi del tempo da soli.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Indovina chi?
programme.desc: Si torna a Pineta nel 19esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Un omicidio costringe Tiziana e Beppe a trasferirsi da Pasquali mentre Viviani e Rimediotti aiutano la Fusco nelle indagini.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Resort Paradiso
programme.desc: Ventesimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original con i protagonisti del BarLume. Fra criminali, omicidi irrisolti e professionisti dell'inganno, un'avventura in cui niente e' come sembra.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - E allora zumba!
programme.desc: Un nuovo caso a Pineta nella 21esima storia della produzione Sky Original. Mentre tutti sono occupati, l'omicidio della pediatra getta nel panico un papa' iper ansioso come Beppe.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il pozzo dei desideri
programme.desc: 22esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Un morto in un pozzo dà il via all’estate con un caso per la Fusco, uno sfratto per Massimo, Tizi e Beppe e un guaio per Pasquali.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La girata
programme.desc: Nuove indagini nel 23esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Durante una battuta di caccia tra amici ci scappa il morto. Un incidente? Solo la Fusco e Massimo sapranno darci una risposta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Sopra la panca
programme.desc: 24esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original con i protagonisti del BarLume. Mentre il padre di Tiziana sparisce all'improvviso, un cadavere trovato in mare fa partire una nuova indagine.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Non e' un paese per bimbi
programme.desc: Si torna a indagare nel 25esimo film targato Sky Original. Gino è sparito e sulle sue tracce c’è una coppia improbabile coinvolta in un traffico di diamanti.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Gatte da pelare
programme.desc: 26esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre la Fusco è a caccia della Rusic, Cioni e Govoni cercano di risolvere un caso da soli mettendo in difficoltà Pasquali.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Sasso carta forbici
programme.desc: 27esimo film ambientato a Pineta. A un passo dall’uscita della sua hit, Marchino scopre il cadavere della sua agente mentre i bimbi trovano un video hot di Pasquali.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il re dei giochi
programme.desc: Giallo e risate nella prima commedia targata Sky Cinema tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Un incidente d'auto scatena le fantasie investigative di Massimo e degli arzilli vecchietti.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La carta più alta
programme.desc: Seconda commedia con Filippo Timi, tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Il mistero sul passaggio di proprieta' di un terreno innesca una catena d'eventi e una nuova indagine.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La tombola dei troiai
programme.desc: Terza commedia Sky Cinema tratta dai romanzi di Marco Malvaldi. Il tradizionale scambio dei regali brutti avra' un ruolo fondamentale nella scoperta dell'assassino del farmacista di Pineta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La briscola in cinque
programme.desc: Quarta commedia con Filippo Timi tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Il ritrovamento del cadavere di una ragazza da' vita a un'indagine che coinvolge di nuovo il barista-detective.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il telefono senza fili
programme.desc: Quinto film prodotto da Sky Cinema tratto dai romanzi di Marco Malvaldi. Durante un'estate caldissima, la scomparsa di una donna scatena macabre ipotesi e maliziosi pettegolezzi.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Azione e reazione
programme.desc: Sesta commedia targata Sky Cinema ispirata ai racconti di Marco Malvaldi. La morte di un turista avvia le indagini della Fusco e il bar di Massimo e' al centro della scena del crimine.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Aria di mare
programme.desc: Settima commedia targata Sky Cinema ispirata ai racconti di Marco Malvaldi. Quando viene ritrovato il corpo di una donna, la Fusco cerca di riscattarsi aiutata dall'immancabile Massimo.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La loggia del cinghiale
programme.desc: Ottavo film Sky Cinema tratto dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Gli allegri vecchietti trascinano Massimo a una festa di addio al celibato dove pero' ci scappa il morto.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Un due tre stella!
programme.desc: Nona commedia targata Sky con vecchi e nuovi personaggi (Stefano Fresi, Corrado Guzzanti). Il ritrovamento di un cadavere e la scomparsa di Viviani scuotono la comunita' di Pineta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La battaglia navale
programme.desc: La decima storia tratta dal romanzo di Marco Malvaldi ci riporta a Pineta. Il ritrovamento del cadavere di una donna al largo della baia di Calaluna da' il via alle indagini.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il battesimo di Ampelio
programme.desc: Undicesimo film targato Sky tratto dal mondo dei romanzi di Marco Malvaldi. Il neoarrivato Beppe e il commissario Fusco indagano sulla misteriosa morte di un prete.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Hasta pronto Viviani
programme.desc: Dodicesima commedia targata Sky, tratta dal mondo dei romanzi di Marco Malvaldi, con Filippo Timi. Mentre Massimo e' sparito in Argentina, l'omicidio di un latitante sconvolge Pineta.

programme.desc: Tra campionati di beach volley, cervi in fuga e giri di scommesse clandestine i nostri protagonisti del BarLume si troveranno a indagare sull’ennesimo misterioso omicidio.

programme.title: CSI S5 E09 - Mea Culpa
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: CYCLE AROUND JAPAN Highlights
programme.desc: Aomori is beautiful, but its northern climate can be harsh. Our cyclist enjoys the warmest of welcomes in communities that historically had to cooperate closely in everything in order to survive.

programme.title: Rockie and Her Friends
programme.desc: Puppet action show for children. In a distant post-human future where surviving creatures have formed a community, new-breed dinosaur girl Rockie sets out on hilarious adventures with her schoolmates.

programme.title: u\u0026i
programme.desc: This show for kids promotes a greater understanding for people with difficulties and helps develop empathy. With the help of two fairies, the main character thinks about what can be done to help.

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Pik Pak Boom
programme.desc: Pik Pak Boom is a 1988 Filipino anthology comedy film directed by Leroy Salvador and starring Herbert Bautista, Lea Salonga, Lilet, Bing Loyzaga, Regine Velasquez, and Dingdong Avanzado. The film consists of two segments: \"Manyika\" (lit. 'Doll') and \"Banana Q\".

programme.title: Kurdapya ep 2
programme.desc: Kurdapya tells the story of long-lost twins, KURING \u0026 DAPHNE. They meet after a strange accident and discover that they lead extremely different lives. Kuring grew up with the cruel extended family in the province while Daphne is an undervalued publishing executive in the city. Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Tom Cruise berperan sebagai seorang tentara AS yang harus menghentikan terjadinya pembinasaan umat manusia akibat kebangkitan seorang putri dari zaman kuno yang telah memendam kedengkian selama ribuan tahun.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Will Smith dan Martin Lawrence berperan sebagai dua polisi Miami yang harus bertukar identitas untuk melacak seorang pencuri heroin dan menyelamatkan departemen tempat mereka bertugas.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli hewan militer turun tangan saat suatu taman hiburan yang berisi sekawanan dinosaurus hasil rekayasa genetika berubah mengerikan bagi para wisatawan karena salah satu dinosaurus lepas dari kandang.

programme.title: Battleship
programme.desc: Sebuah koalisi angkatan laut internasional menjadi harapan terakhir bagi kelangsungan kehidupan di dunia kala mereka terlibat pertempuran dengan sekelompok alien jahat dalam film aksi petualangan epik ini.

programme.title: Tai Chi Master
programme.desc: Dua sahabat mengambil jalan berbeda saat terseret dalam pemberontakan melawan pemerintah. Salah satunya tumbuh menjadi komandan militer, sementara yang lain memilih mempelajari teknik Tai Chi yang menenangkan.

programme.title: Tears Of The Sun
programme.desc: Seorang anggota Navy SEAL ditugaskan untuk menyelamatkan seorang dokter Amerika yang terdampar di perang yang melanda Nigeria, namun ia menghadapi banyak masalah yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Deckard Shaw berusaha membalaskan dendamnya kepada Dominic Toretto dan keluarganya untuk saudaranya yang sedang terbaring koma.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen dan Peeta Mellark menjadi incaran Capitol setelah kemenangan mereka di Hunger Games ke-74 memicu aksi pemberontakan di semua distrik di Panem.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgement Day
programme.desc: Sesosok siborg nan identik dengan siborg yang gagal membunuh Sarah Connor kini harus melindungi putranya yang berusia sepuluh tahun, John, dari siborg lain yang lebih canggih dan kuat.

programme.title: Get Out

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
programme.desc: Assassin John Wick is on a mission to fight his way to the High Table and earn his long-sought freedom. However, a new enemy stands in his way with power that turns his old friends into enemies.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programme.desc: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit, and the dwarves retrieve Lonely Mountain and its treasure. However, a fight breaks out between the dwarves, elves and men over it while Azog and his Orc army prepare for war.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Optimus Prime seeks his creator in space. Meanwhile, humans and Autobots join forces to save Earth from an ancient threat.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: When an advanced cyber weapon is on the verge of falling into the wrong hands, Ethan Hunt and his team must embark on a challenging mission to save the world from destruction.

programme.title: Dora and the Lost City of Gold
programme.desc: While searching for a hidden land, the parents of a teenage Dora go missing. Consequently, she and her new high-school friends go in search of the lost city of gold with hopes of finding her parents.

programme.title: Impractical Jokers: The Movie
programme.desc: When four lifelong friends receive three tickets from singer Paula Abdul to her concert, they compete in a series of pranks to decide which amongst them will attend the show.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Steppenwolf and his Parademons return after aeons to destroy Earth. However, Batman seeks the help of Wonder Woman to recruit The Flash, Cyborg and Aquaman to fight their new powerful enemy.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat
programme.desc: To protect Earth from the Outworld, MMA fighter Cole Young sets out to find a group of fighters to defend the planet in a critical tournament.

programme.title: Force of Execution
programme.desc: A gangster, who seeks to retire from the life of crime, faces a threat when an upcoming rival challenges his authority. He then decides to take help from a trustworthy former apprentice.

programme.title: Recoil
programme.desc: When his family is killed by a notorious gang, Ryan Varett, a former police officer, suits up to seek revenge against the perpetrators.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: The key aspects of filmmaking are explored, with behind-the-scenes insights and intriguing interviews with prominent cast and crew members.

programme.title: DSC
programme.desc: Talented directors provide an entertaining insight into the most intriguing stories and anecdotes concerning some of their best works.

programme.title: I Am Wrath
programme.desc: After corrupt cops are unable to catch his wife's killers, Stanley, an unemployed man, teams up with an old friend to avenge her death.

programme.title: Hunt to Kill
programme.desc: A gang of thugs hold captive a US Border Patrol agent and his daughter in the wilderness.

programme.title: Modern Times
programme.desc: A factory production line worker is thrown out on the street for his manic behaviour. He then meets a young, homeless girl, who is recently orphaned, and tries to build a home with her.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A dying curator of the Louvre hides cryptic clues on Da Vinci paintings. Now it is up to Robert Langdon and Sophie Neveu to follow the clues and unearth a secret kept hidden for centuries.
